# Alembic vs Django Migrations

**Provenance**: benchmark ground-truth answer, generated by chroma_kb/populate_benchmark_kb.py from benchmarks/cases_200.json; evaluation material, not a research source.

**Category**: Backend Frameworks & API
**Expected winner**: Alembic

## Analysis

Alembic is framework-agnostic and works with any SQLAlchemy-based project. Django Migrations only works within Django. For non-Django projects, Alembic is the only choice. For Django projects, Django Migrations is tightly integrated.
